messages:
maria_s: Hey team — customer acme (prod) upgraded the Python SDK from 1.11 -> 1.12 and now their Lambda throws TypeError: create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'body'. They call client.responses.create(body=payload)
ben_r: That rings a bell. In 1.12 we renamed the param to `input` in the Responses client but we forgot to keep a `body` kw alias.
alice_w: Ugh. Do we have a quick repro? Request logs + smallest snippet please.
maria_s: Pasting the stack snippet from their CloudWatch: 
```
TypeError: create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'body'
  File "/var/task/handler.py", line 42, in lambda_handler
    resp = client.responses.create(body={"prompt": "hello"})
```
They say rolling back to 1.11 fixes it. Repro snippet from them: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
client.responses.create(body='hello')
```
ben_r: Confirmed on master: signature is `def create(self, input: str, ...)` — no alias. This slipped through during the v1.12 refactor.
support-bot: Escalation created INC-2024-0423 (severity: high) — customer blocked.
oncall-matt: Workaround for now: pass the value positionally rather than as a kwarg: `client.responses.create('hello')` — that should bypass the keyword mismatch. Also recommend pinning: `pip install "redwood-inference==1.11.*"` until we ship a patch.
maria_s: Customer cannot easily change app code (many lambdas). They asked for a short pinned requirements.txt + dockerfile snippet we can send.
oncall-matt: requirements.txt example:
```
# requirements.txt
redwood-inference==1.11.*
other-deps==2.3.0
```
Dockerfile snippet:
```
FROM python:3.10-slim
COPY requirements.txt /
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r /requirements.txt
```
ben_r: I'll prepare a 1.12.1 patch that adds `body` as a kw arg alias and add unit tests for backward compat. ETA ~4 hours after I finish CI. I'll also file a changelog/migration note.
alice_w: Please also add an automated compatibility test to the release pipeline so this doesn't regress.
maria_s: Customer replied: acme-eng: "Pinning to 1.11 fixed our lambdas — thanks. Please notify when 1.12.1 is available so we can validate."
ben_r: I'll post release notes and the patch link here when it's up. PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 (I'll update once CI passes).
alice_w: After patch, we should publish a short support KB with wording: "If you see TypeError about unexpected keyword 'body' after upgrading, pin to 1.11 or use positional arg until 1.12.1 is released."
maria_s: Sending customer the KB + pin instructions now. Marking this thread resolved for support, leaving follow-up for eng to close the INC when 1.12.1 is published. :thumbsup:
